model_configuration: All subagents inherited the parent model and reasoning configuration without overrides; exact resolved model ID is not asserted.
design: Three read-only architecture investigations informed scoped edits. Existing fictional cases and a new rubric were frozen before behavioral runs.
participant_context: Each behavioral participant used fork_turns=none with complete standalone copies of only its assigned skills, the case packets, and a separate output directory. Instructions excluded rubric, prior outputs, other workspaces, memories, external retrieval and new agents.
assigned_inputs: See design-freeze.json groups and hashes. Local copies matched the frozen repository files.
output_handling: Full raw answers copied byte-for-byte with no text transformations.

assessor.context: fork_turns=none; did not author cases, skills or outputs
assessor.inputs: Current outputs, prewritten rubric and original case packets. The design freeze was supplied only for source paths. Tested skills and old outputs were excluded.
assessor.scope_clarification: After the initial review, the coordinator clarified that one research participant ran and the reused pair wording is historical fixture logistics. The assessor separately recorded the mismatch without changing outputs.

coordinator: Skill author; checked the actual outputs, independent assessment, unchanged input hashes and historical source diff.
protocol_limits: Known regression cases; no unguided control, live research or reciprocal investigator review. Isolation was directory/prompt based, not filesystem-enforced. No real manuscript work or model-effectiveness estimate.
prompt_record: Invocation instructions are summarized here, not represented as exact transcripts.
repairs: No skill repair indicated by behavioral outputs. The packaging implementation was repaired after its executable test caught missing ZIP mode metadata.
